'''Ash glaze''' is a type of [[glaze]] that can be applied to jugs, statues, large pots, and crafts made of stone or [[ceramic]]s. It is applied to these items by a [[glazer]] at a [[kiln]] or [[magma kiln]] by using a bar of [[ash]]. [[Earthenware]] [[jug]]s and [[pot]]s can be glazed to allow them to hold liquids.

Unlike [[tin glaze]], the association between ash glaze and its source material is hardcoded into the game itself.
